body:
## Authority and goal

Follow [the current architecture and P5 plan](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/main/docs/governing/current.md#next-phase-p5-native-workflow-product-evaluation), established by #60 / PR #61. Evaluate the existing thin integration and the quality of its task outcomes; do not inherit the historical v0.5 assurance checklist. This issue records planned work, not authorization to launch unbudgeted provider runs or a claim that P5 has passed.

## Scope

Use the existing Python boundary to demonstrate criteria-only admission through native submission, durable correlation/reconnection and an actual authorized PR receipt-backed disposition. Independently assess the exact accepted revisions against their frozen task criteria using a small set of valid and meaningfully challenging cases. Reuse current deterministic integration/lifecycle tests instead of recreating native graph tests.

Before live runs, record the product/dependency baseline, authorized disposable GitHub repository/branch, compatible DirectTarget and operator-owned profile, required authentication, run/spend limits, independent judging criteria and safe host teardown arrangements. Missing prerequisites must remain explicit blockers to the corresponding live claims.

## Completion

Retain a reproducible evaluation record distinguishing controlled seam checks, live delivery, real-provider task quality, infrastructure failures and capability gaps. Report observed correct outcomes, false acceptance, unjustified rejection/noncompletion and relevant correction/cost observations, with honest sample limitations and an evidence-backed readiness recommendation for the authorized-PR native profile.

No-effect runs still cannot successfully disposition without a stable local result. All dispatched Attempts remain quarantined against automatic cleanup/replacement. P5 must preserve those limits, not silently fix them with supervision or snapshot machinery. No custom graph/evidence worker/adjudicator/final-assessor protocol, broader effects, new CLI/service or model-tuning campaign is required by this issue.

The superseded #3, #5 and #6 gates are not dependencies. Historical G1–G4 results remain evidence only for their recorded profiles.

---

## Execution tracker — decomposed 17 September 2026

**Status: #63 completed; its frozen protocol was prospectively amended to v2 before any live result, and live preflight remains BLOCKED. #64–#66 are unstarted. P5 verdict: NOT REVIEWED.** The original scope above is preserved. This issue is the parent/tracker; perform the distinct work in the four children below rather than starting a parallel parent implementation.

Inspected current `main` at decomposition: [`b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/tree/b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068). Authority was checked first, then this issue, current production admission/submission/SDK/disposition/abandonment code and tests, followed by the native integration/source/result-handoff documents. The open-issue check before decomposition found only this issue. No concrete source-backed refactor/test-cleanup prerequisite was identified; no new cleanup phase is included.

### Dependency-ordered children

- [x] #63 — Freeze evaluation protocol and record live-run preflight. Initial v1 was frozen at [`717e94b3548d1dc029bfb54e2758e9929f1d93bd`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/commit/717e94b3548d1dc029bfb54e2758e9929f1d93bd) with the [corpus/judging](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/717e94b3548d1dc029bfb54e2758e9929f1d93bd/evaluation/p5/v1/corpus.md) and [BLOCKED preflight](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/717e94b3548d1dc029bfb54e2758e9929f1d93bd/evaluation/p5/v1/preflight.md). Before any live result, the decision rules were prospectively refined as [`p5-native-pr-v2`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/1d581717509de182410c3ab2f54d3f65768d8d7f/evaluation/p5/v2/protocol.md) at [`1d581717509de182410c3ab2f54d3f65768d8d7f`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/commit/1d581717509de182410c3ab2f54d3f65768d8d7f). v1 remains preserved provenance; v2 governs future live dispatch. Completion is not live authorization.
- [ ] #64 — Validate the live authorized-PR product boundary. Depends on #63 plus satisfied live prerequisites and explicit authorization; establishes actual DirectTarget/GitHub PR handoff, stable receipt, durable disposition and caller reconnection. **Not ready for live execution: preflight B01–B09 unresolved and operator authorization must bind the v2 freeze commit.**
- [ ] #65 — Run the bounded real-provider outcome-quality evaluation. Depends on #63 and successful compatible #64 boundary evidence; independently judges exact accepted revisions and retains all outcomes, errors and sample limitations.
- [ ] #66 — Skeptically review native-profile evidence and record readiness. Reviews #63–#65 evidence or their explicit failure/blocked/not-run dispositions; records review status separately from PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED and a scoped readiness recommendation.

Normal execution order: **#63 → #64 → #65 → #66**. A failed/blocked boundary must not trigger a quality campaign through another path. #66 may review a settled incomplete evidence package and record FAIL/BLOCKED without requiring unavailable or unjustified extra runs. Checked boxes/closed issues mean work has been dispositioned, not that P5 passed.

### Why these four boundaries

[Current result tests](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068/tests/test_workflow_result.py) exercise synthetic PR receipts and a real-native, controlled-provider no-effect refusal. They already protect Broodling's receipt/lifecycle decisions but do not establish a live GitHub PR handoff or real-provider task quality. [Production disposition](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068/broodling/disposition.py) checks receipt/current authority, not independent semantic correctness. Thus protocol design, actual delivery, measured provider outcomes and skeptical evidence review have materially different prerequisites or evidence meaning. Individual tasks, metrics, setup actions and negative test cases remain inside those units.

A live boundary run can count toward quality only if #63 predeclares that use and it actually meets the real-provider and independent-judging conditions; count it once. Controlled fixtures cannot replace live delivery, and controlled-provider results cannot replace real-provider quality evidence. No mandatory internal repair trace or seeded repair campaign is introduced.

### #63 disposition and prospective v2 refinement — 17 September 2026

The corpus remains eight serial trials (four tasks, two repetitions), all criteria-only, with exact-receipt judging and all-started accounting. R01 remains the #64 boundary trial and counts once; no provider substitutions, extra boundary runs or rerun-until-green are permitted. The corpus is explicitly a small purposive coverage set, not a statistical sample capable of supporting a meaningful reliability percentage.

`p5-native-pr-v2` therefore removes `7/8 CO` as an independent quantitative acceptance threshold. Raw counts/fractions remain descriptive. The positive gate is claim-level: supported-suite and live-boundary evidence must pass; all eight frozen slots must be accounted for with determinate judgments; every task must have a correct observation; false acceptance is disqualifying; unresolved infrastructure/capability/indeterminate/legitimate-refusal observations cannot be hidden; and at most one isolated unjustified noncompletion may remain only when the paired repetition for that task is correct. A second unjustified noncompletion or two non-correct repetitions of one task makes the positive gate impossible. #66 remains free to reject readiness even when that minimum evidence pattern is present if the retained failure materially undermines the scoped claim. These rules are prospective evidence rules, not a reliability estimate.

The initial freeze and v2 refinement are author-reviewed; no independent peer approval or operator authorization is claimed. The v2 amendment occurred before any live provider/PR evaluation result. Offline evaluator controls from v1 passed, but `python -m pytest tests` remains **NOT RUN / BLOCKED** because that session lacked the pinned SDK/test dependencies and a complete runnable checkout. Approved runs/spend remain zero; the requested maximum caps are not approval. Production, existing tests, dependencies, governing architecture and historical qualification are unchanged.

### Shared execution and change limits

The next action is still to resolve the [named live preflight blockers B01–B09](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/717e94b3548d1dc029bfb54e2758e9929f1d93bd/evaluation/p5/v1/preflight.md#live-preflight-decision-and-required-operator-bindings): a supported complete suite result, authorized disposable repository/branch and entitled trial allocations, compatible DirectTarget/provider and operator-owned sandbox policy, authentication/credential availability, explicit effect/run/spend approval, safe external stop/teardown/quarantine capacity, and independent judging/durable evidence retention. Bind actual resources and approvals to the exact **v2 freeze commit `1d581717509de182410c3ab2f54d3f65768d8d7f`** before #64 dispatch. Further measurement changes require another prospective protocol version, not adjustments after results. #64/#65 have not begun.

Zeroshot continues to own standard workflow execution/review/repair and authorized native delivery. Broodling retains admission, current Attempt/run authority, effect authorization, receipt validation and lifecycle disposition. Preserve no-effect stable-local-result refusal and quarantine of all dispatched Attempts. Independent judging is evaluation-only; operator host teardown is outside Broodling and cannot grant cleanup/replacement authority.

The children may retain new evaluation documentation/evidence and minimal evaluation-only tooling as scoped individually. They do not authorize production redesign, generic refactoring, test cleanup, dependency/model tuning, custom graph/evidence/adjudicator/final-assessor/supervisor machinery, broader effects or new packaging. A discovered concrete blocking defect needs its own narrowly justified disposition and an explicitly recorded baseline change, not a hidden prerequisite phase. Historical evidence remains unchanged.

Update this tracker with #66's evidence links, reviewed scope, explicit verdict and remaining blockers. Do not close it as a successful P5 solely because the children have reports or the current unit suite is green.
title: [P5] Evaluate the native workflow product boundary and outcome quality
